name: How long do interior damage repair projects typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long do interior damage repair projects typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of interior damage repair projects varies greatly depending on the complexity and extent of the damage. A small drywall patch might take a few hours, while extensive water damage restoration involving drying, demolition, and reconstruction could take several weeks. Once City Dweller assesses your specific situation, we will provide a clear timeline estimate during the proposal phase, ensuring you know what to expect.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by damage extent; small repairs are quick, while extensive restoration can take weeks. City Dweller provides a timeline after assessment.
